title: Connected Nations 2025 - Data downloads / About this data - fixed broadband coverage
findings: The 2025 fixed-broadband package uses an r01 version token in the ZIP target: 202507_fixed_broadband_coverage_r01.zip.
The About-this-data PDF documents 121 all-premises postcode CSV files in folder postcode_files, one per postcode area, named 202507_fixed_postcode_coverage_r01_xx.csv.
It separately documents 121 residential postcode CSV files in folder postcode_res_files, named 202507_fixed_postcode_res_coverage_r01_xx.csv.
The documented all-premises postcode rows total 1,737,468 and residential postcode rows total 1,602,391.
The same PDF states postcode-level coverage does not report full-fibre coverage due to commercial confidentiality, while gigabit-capable coverage is reported.
relevance_to_first_missing_criterion: Historical official structural precedent only: it validates Ofcom fixed-coverage archive version-token/file-family conventions and the 121-postcode-area member pattern. It does not establish the Spring 2026 corrected-r2 archive byte hash, CRCs, exact 2026 member names, or content.
